headline: Bursa Auto Dealers' Chamber Chairman Yanık on the ÖTV Regulation: Uncertainty Has Started Trading
summary: Bursa Auto Dealers' Chamber chairman Hakan Yanık said expected activity has not materialised in the used vehicle market. He pointed to price uncertainty after the new special consumption tax rules.
why: Special consumption tax changes on vehicles alter car prices and demand, a key indicator for Turkey's consumer spending and auto sector.
